source_name: Friction of carbon fibre tows (University of Cambridge)
material_domain: Carbon-fibre tow (T700 12k, 60E and 50C sizing) sliding on a glass tool
measurement_protocol: Tow-on-tool sliding friction under a 14-step increasing normal-load ramp
target_definition: Workbook 'Coefficient of Friction' = friction force per contact / total normal load
caveats: Five sequential load sweeps are labelled Test 1-5 per tow type; the workbook does not expose a specimen serial number, so independence of the sweeps is assumed from the labels rather than proven.
The first ramp steps sit near zero applied load, where the ratio response is unstable; those rows are retained and reported, not silently dropped.
